tester.responsibility: Author executable AC tests (AC-M1..AC-M9) from slot 2 + slot-1 surfaces only, before the doer. Derive the mask/conservation oracle from canonical-SPDI set membership and hand-computed domain/gene aggregates, never from the tool's own ledger. AC-M3 proves a non-firing held-out variant injected into an aggregate is still flagged (zero-incidence mask). AC-M7 proves full VUS resources are byte-unchanged.

doer.responsibility: Implement mask_clinvar.py + CLI + config to pass the ACs. Mask the upstream ClinVar source (VCF/Nirvana JSON + summary tables) by canonical SPDI + VariationID; emit masked namespace + manifest + provenance + independent conservation audit. Never import bias_2015 or reimplement a generator's aggregation. Honor slot 3.

checker.responsibility: Re-verify all ACs pass, the frozen preservation set + full-resource hashes are byte-unchanged, and none of the five slot-3 inversion failures are present (incidence-driven mask shrink, raw-coordinate miss, silent over-removal, full-resource contamination, aggregate laundering).
